entry.title: AvaloniaUI/Avalonia - Releases - 2026-11-02
entry.content:
12.1.5

What's Changed

Enhancements

  • Core – Refresh indexer bindings on Item[] and Item[key] notifications by @Evan260 in #22227
  • Core – Resolve Bidi W2 strong context in one forward pass by @spicelogic in #22545
  • Core – Update XML comments in ICustomHitTest by @luke-whos-here in #22557
  • Controls – Expose TextPresenter.CursorRectangle as a public property by @theworker02 in #22319
  • Controls – Implement IExpandCollapseProvider on TreeViewItemAutomationPeer by @grokys in #22565
  • Controls – Relax DrawerPage/NavigationPage Border template parts to Decorator by @rabbitism in #22621
  • Controls – Use ordinal key comparison in Fluent theme resource providers by @maxkatz6 in #22631
  • Windows – Make BeginMoveDrag and BeginResizeDrag work with touch by @Evan260 in #22229
  • Windows – Allow Alt+Space to open the system menu by @caesay in #22520
  • macOS – Implement accessibilityActivationPoint on automation elements by @jeff377 in #22548
  • Wayland – Report popup positions by @kekekeks in #22291

Fixes

  • Core – Support StylableElement for styles inside ContainerQueries by @OleRoss in #22167
  • Core – Make AssemblyDescriptorResolver cache thread-safe by @avinashcodelabs in #22352
  • Core – Fix Tapped when target moves by @Evan260 in #22427
  • Core – Require the same button for both clicks of a double tap by @Evan260 in #22429
  • Core – Fix TextLayout.HitTestPoint IsInside for multi-line and aligned text by @sean-reed in #22433
  • Core – Make Typeface.Normalize tolerate repeated and trailing whitespace in a font family name by @EremexBot in #22487
  • Core – Fix a crash when a control moves to another top level during layout by @Evan260 in #22491
  • Core – Align Dispatcher to the platform clock with an offset by @George-Payne in #22496
  • Core – Fix NRE when the application shuts down while showing the main window by @mfkl in #22497
  • Core – Fix Skia path bounds races and disposed stroke cache reuse by @hez2010 in #22504
  • Core – Fix paragraph end handling in bidirectional text lines by @Gillibald in #22553
  • Core – Limit the line break search to the reach of the current line by @Gillibald in #22554
  • Core – Stop AvaloniaList from throwing when asked whether it contains an invalid item by @TomEdwardsEnscape in #22577
  • Core – Fix concurrent FallbackStorageProvider calls failing after the first success by @izakusilov in #22596
  • Core – Use ordinal comparisons for pseudoclass checks and IterationCount.Parse by @hazeliscoding in #22604
  • Core – Dispose the buffer ShapeTogether splits between its runs by @hazeliscoding in #22626
  • Controls – Don't change page in TabbedPage if focus is owned by a child element by @emmauss in #22337
  • Controls – Keep focus in the text box when an AutoCompleteBox item is picked by @Evan260 in #22356
  • Controls – Don't use a control's type name as the automation name of ContentControl by @glennawatson in #22378
  • Controls – Fix menu auto closing when reopened by @MrJul in #22399
  • Controls – Fix ComboBox.WrapSelection when there is nothing to select by @NLick47 in #22423
  • Controls – Fix PipsPager list sizing and scroll offset reset when page count changes by @austinaviv in #22426
  • Controls – Clear the ComboBox pressed state when it loses pointer capture by @Evan260 in #22428
  • Controls – Fix title bar text by @Evan260 in #22455
  • Controls – Click a button on a space key up only if it was pressed by @Evan260 in #22456
  • Controls – Fix Popup.InheritsTransform using the X scale for the Y axis by @jeff377 in #22457
  • Controls – Don't expose a masked TextBox's text through its automation peer by @jeff377 in #22458
  • Controls – Fix Window arrange when its size is platform constrained by @MrJul in #22488
  • Controls – Make the keyboard work inside a picker popup by @Evan260 in #22489
  • Controls – Make CommandBar overflow scrollable in both themes by @masonliiu in #22556
  • Controls – Backport some ColorPicker Fluent2 theme fixes/updates to older themes by @robloo in #22578
  • Controls – Fix several ColorPicker issues by @robloo in #22579
  • Controls – Fix always true condition in VirtualizingStackPanel.RealizeElements by @izakusilov in #22595
  • Controls – Use SetCurrentValue in automation peers by @MrJul in #22608
  • Controls – Make the Calendar wait for a whole wheel notch before stepping by @hazeliscoding in #22609
  • Controls – Fix popups with pointer placement not resizing when their content grows by @Om-singhaI in #22624
  • Windows – Fix GetDpiForMonitor P/Invoke return type (x86 ignored DPI scaling) by @hamitturkukaya in #22419
  • Windows – Accept a combination of media in the Win32 OLE data object by @AtakanUk in #22531
  • Windows – Return immediately from IInvokeProvider.Invoke by @MrJul in #22562
  • Windows – Fix Screen.DisplayName always being null by @izakusilov in #22593
  • macOS – Fix crash when a live region's text is cleared by @jeff377 in #22463
  • macOS – Report context menus as AXMenu by @jeff377 in #22517
  • macOS – Allow setting AXFocused only on keyboard-focusable elements by @jeff377 in #22532
  • macOS – Bump MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET to 12.0 by @maxkatz6 in #22633
  • X11 – Add windows to AT-SPI on the UI thread after the server starts by @glennawatson in #22379
  • X11 – Use 32-bit visual for EGL alpha configs on Mesa without EGL_MESA_x11_native_visual_id by @kekekeks in #22452
  • X11 – Implement IDispatcherImplWithExplicitBackgroundProcessing and some restructure of X11PlatformThreading by @kekekeks in #22453
  • X11 – Re-read the window position after reparenting by @grokys in #22555
  • Linux – Report removed and added children in children-changed signals by @glennawatson in #22398
  • Linux – Fix unobserved task exception at exit from DBusTextInputMethodBase.Dispose by @izakusilov in #22594
  • Linux – Fix X11 keycode conversion for IBus by @kekekeks in #22625
  • Linux – Report popups with the window role by @grokys in #22641
  • Linux – Report the active state only for the active window by @jmacato in #22642
  • Android – Fix #22420: ACTION_SET_TEXT should replace text, not append by @PreetRajput in #22435
  • iOS – Keep the keyboard up when focus moves between text boxes by @NicholasLachapelle in #22529
  • Browser – Fix WASM MT on .NET 11 runtime by @maxkatz6 in #22444
  • Browser – Use Command-based hotkeys on Apple platforms by @maxkatz6 in #22468

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-02
entry.content:
Azure.Provisioning.StorageActions_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-10-27)

Features Added

  • Initial release of Azure.Provisioning.StorageActions.

Azure.ResourceManager.Cdn_1.6.0

1.6.0 (2026-10-29)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-10-01.
  • Added support for creating a rule set together with its rules in batch mode via FrontDoorRuleSetData.IsBatchMode and FrontDoorRuleSetData.Rules.
  • Added server TLS group configuration via AfdServerTlsGroupPolicy and AfdServerTlsGroup.
  • Added CertificateNameCheckValidationMode and CustomCertificateSubjects to Front Door origins.
  • Added TokenDestinationHeader to OriginAuthenticationProperties.

Breaking Changes

  • Removed preview-only features introduced in 1.6.0-beta.1 (api-version 2025-09-01-preview) that are not part of the stable api-version 2026-10-01, including key groups, web agents, profile agents, deployment versions, and embedded WAF policies.

Azure.Template_1.0.3-beta.7020321

1.0.3-beta.7020321 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Added WidgetAnalyticsClientSettings to support creating a WidgetAnalyticsClient from IConfiguration, including configuration-based credential resolution and dependency injection registration.

entry.content:

  • [Tracer] Event Grid instrumentation (#8911)

  • [Debugger] Fix native stack buffer overflow on large return type signatures (#9388)
  • Fix baggage leak between Kafka messages (#9529)

Changes

Tracer

  • [Tracer] Event Grid instrumentation (#8911)
  • Refactor ApiWebRequest (#9145)
  • [AAS] Recover agent processes after overlapped recycles, and log their lifecycle (#9397)
  • [Tracer] Use double precision for trace sampling rates (#9467)
  • Use branchless hex encoding in HexString.ToHexBytes (#9503)
  • [Tracer] Decode percent-encoded OTLP header values (#9516)
  • Fix OTLP sampling rule return type (#9561)
  • Guard OnActivityWithSourceStopped for null Activity (#9584)

CI Visibility

  • [CI Visibility] Fix message loss and abandoned mutexes in the IPC channel (#9335)
  • [Test Optimization] Add NUnit 5 support (#9407)
  • [Test Optimization] Add dynamic automatic test retries (#9480)

ASM

  • [IAST] Skip frames without debug info when choosing the vulnerability location (#9332)
  • [AppSec] Emit appsec.waf.config_errors telemetry (#9481)

Continuous Profiler

  • [profiler tests] keep profiler mock agent listener alive when test handlers throw and decompress gzipped telemetry (#9367)
  • [Profiler] Fix "Delayed start failure creates a logical zombie" issue (#9403)

Debugger

  • [Debugger] DEBUG-4637 Fix DI remote enablement (#9344)
  • [Debugger] Fix native stack buffer overflow on large return type signatures (#9388)
  • [Debugger] Report telemetry metrics in the debugger namespace (#9423)
  • [Debugger] DEBUG-5961 Emit lowercase {redacted} placeholder in expression templates (#9482)
  • [Debugger] Support snapshot sampling below 1 per second (#9496)
  • [Debugger] Treat StackOverflowException as unsupported for Exception Replay (#9499)
  • [Debugger] Add root timestamp to snapshot payloads (#9532)
  • [Debugger] Remove probes when Dynamic Instrumentation is disabled remotely (#9560)
  • [Debugger] Update safety guide and add redaction guardrails (#9562)
  • [Debugger] Add Dynamic Instrumentation rules to /sdk-review (#9566)

Serverless

  • [Serverless] Respect DD_TRACE_ENABLED in AWS Lambda integration (#9424)
  • [Serverless] Use aca.function.* tag prefix in Azure Container Apps (#9479)

Fixes

  • [Tracer] Fix Azure Service Bus producer/consumer trace disconnect for ServiceBusProcessor (#8867)
  • [Feature Flags] Preserve 256 attributes alongside targeting key (#9511)
  • Fix baggage leak between Kafka messages (#9529)
  • Fix DynamoDB instrumentation for AWS SDK 4.0.109.3+ (#9555)

Build / Test

  • Update Testcontainers infrastructure (#9066)
  • Normalize resource schema URLs in OTLP snapshots added in 1.19.0 (#9298)
  • [Tracer] Warm up OpenSSL with SHA-256 instead of MD5 (#9329)
  • [Tracing] Test stable Quartz 4 releases (#9385)
  • [CI] Bump LLM validation platform to v0.1.5 (#9420)
  • [Smoke Test Docker Image Bump] Updating docker image tags (#9459)
  • Add ability to skip running Azure DevOps CI (#9473)
  • Clarify LLM benchmark criteria (#9484)
  • Ensure alpine.build.dockerfile can still build (#9502)
  • Consolidate versioning approach for the tracer (#9521)
  • Stop trusting compromised eMudhra roots in CI and smoke-test images (#9527)
  • Stop trusting compromised eMudhra roots in the build-toolchain images (#9528)
  • Move AutoInstrumentation.Generator to tools folder (#9549)
  • Remove unused Python requirements from Windows GitLab image (#9550)
  • Fix some apm-serverless CODEOWNERS (#9556)
  • [Smoke Test Docker Image Bump] Updating docker image tags (#9557)
  • Bump the gh-actions-packages group across 2 directories with 3 updates (#9558)
  • Remove the phrase skip ci within the square brackets from the PR template (#9588)

Miscellaneous

  • Migrate Couchbase tests to Testcontainers (#9108)
  • [Feature Flags] Add privacy-protected flagevaluation EVP events through the Agent (#9351)
  • [DBM] Add Oracle stored-procedure service comments (#9415)
  • [Tracer] Wake up the trace serialization and DogStatsD threads at shutdown (#9419)
  • Make CI curl calls fail on HTTP errors and retry (#9450)
  • Add agent skill for introducing lint and static analysis rules (#9464)
  • [Feature Flags] Add debug logging for provider onboarding (#9465)
  • fix(otel-metrics): export the aggregation temporality stored on MetricPoint (#9468)
  • Implement /sdk-review lens-based review skill (#9471)
  • Seed .NET review rules in /sdk-review (#9472)
  • fix(otel): treat empty OTEL_* environment variables as unset (#9497)
  • [OTLP] Export the tracer's sampling decision in OTLP traces (#9498)
  • fix(otel): unify OTLP endpoint and protocol resolution (#9505)
  • Revert "[DBM] Add Oracle stored-procedure service comments (#9415)" (#9525)
  • [Tracer] Use the Default sampling mechanism in OTLP mode when no rule is configured (#9531)

Data Streams Monitoring

  • [DSM] Fix RabbitMQ time in queue treating AMQP timestamp seconds as milliseconds (#9455)
  • [DSM] Fix sync Kinesis GetRecords never recording consume checkpoints (#9456)

entry.title: grpc/grpc - Releases - 2026-11-02
entry.content:
Release v1.83.2

This is release 1.83.2 (garden) of gRPC Core.

For gRPC documentation, see grpc.io. For previous releases, see Releases.

This release contains refinements, improvements, and bug fixes, with highlights listed below.

Core

  • [Backport][v1.83.x][security] Update gRPC repo roots. (#43740)
  • [Security] Default to Post-Quantum Cryptography in TLS key exchange. (#42560)
  • [authz] don't pass RBAC policy by value when constructing authorization engine. (#42636)

C#

  • Migrate CSharp Grpc.Tools to new DotNet Version. (#42661)
  • [C#] Tools - Build: Fix protoc SIGSEGV on ARM64 by aligning max-page-size and migrating to manylinux_2_28. (#42590)

Python

  • [Backport][v1.83.x][export] Internal change. (#43792)
  • [Backport][v1.83.x][Python] Fix the StatusCode Enums to be int. (#43252)
  • [Backport][v1.83.x][Python] grpc-status: Relax protobuf dependency lower bound to allow 6.x. (#43001)
  • [Python] Add abort_with_status to the aio ServicerContext ABC. (#42733)
  • [Python] Update lower bound for protobuf from 6.33.5 to 7.35.1. (#42914)
  • [Python] Pyright typeCheckingMode - standard. (#42739)
  • [Python] Support 3.15 - Update docker images which include 3.15.0b2. (#42374)
  • [Python] Support Python 3.15 - Upgrade bazel dep rules_python to 2.0.2. (#42637)
  • [Python] Handle _InactiveRpcError pytorch exception wrapper edge case. (#42644)
  • [Python] Hide internal symbols from Python's cygrpc shared object. (#42325)
  • [Python] Handle custom Interceptor exceptions in InterceptedCall APIs . (#42593)
